description: How bad is space weather right now? Returns the current NOAA space weather scales for radio blackouts (R), solar radiation storms (S) and geomagnetic storms (G), the maximum of the past 24 hours, and NOAA SWPC probabilities for the next 3 days. Useful for HF radio users, pilots, drone and GPS users, satellite and grid operators and journalists. It gives levels and probabilities, not impact assessments for a specific system. (cost: 1 credit)
name: space_weather_scales
